entities.name: Main sulfur heterocycle
observations: The molecule contains two sulfur atoms: one aryl/heteroaromatic sulfur and one more aliphatic thioether sulfur in a fused ring.

entities.name: mCPBA
observations: SELFIES decodes to O=C(OO)C1=CC=CC(Cl)=C1, chloroperoxybenzoic acid, a sulfur-oxidizing peroxyacid.

entities.name: mCPBA oxidation in DCM
observations: The supplied components include mCPBA, dichloromethane, and oxygen/water representation; dichloromethane is consistent with solvent and mCPBA commonly oxidizes sulfides to sulfoxides or sulfones.

entities.name: Selective sulfur oxidation
observations: A plausible transformation is insertion of one oxygen at the more accessible aliphatic thioether sulfur, giving a sulfoxide; excess mCPBA can further oxidize it to the sulfone.
The aryl/heteroaromatic sulfur is generally less likely to be the first oxidation site than the saturated thioether sulfur.
